description:
Outcome: Allocated gardener reports a problem with their plot, from brief.md: First version must 4
Scope: Validated plain-text report tied server-side to own allocated plot and season; confirmation and own report status; creation timestamp. Excludes: Attachments and chat
Acceptance: Cannot submit for another household's plot or without an active allocation; invalid descriptions explained; retries do not duplicate reports
Behaviour: No-allocation guidance; accessible submission/loading/error/retry; escape malicious text
Verification: Authorization, validation, duplicate submission and phone journey tests. Prerequisites: T-003, T-007, T-005. Assumptions: Reports require active allocation; historical reports retained privately after season
title: Plot problem reporting
